commit 64a9f9e97e03f5f9d7087293990a7abcc5f36f94
Author: Tiago Vilas Boas <author@example.com>
Date:   Tue Nov 10 16:42:46 2026 -0300

    feat(setup): inline wizard with Essential/Complete/Custom profiles and a closing summary (#53)
    
    The setup wizard draws in place below the command instead of on the alternate screen. A Profile step after the harnesses offers Essential (the default), Complete and Custom; component lines say what each part does; a run ends with a summary, the equivalent command and next steps. A profile never selects a component a flag turned off or a destructive one.

@@ -11,6 +11,7 @@ and this project adheres to [Semantic Versioning](https://semver.org/spec/v2.0.0
 
 ### Changed
 
+- `downshift setup` wizard: it draws in place below the command instead of full screen, so the choices stay in the terminal history; a new **Profile** step after the harnesses offers *Essential* (hooks, plugin, steering, project policy; the default), *Complete* (every component on by default, then the worker question) and *Custom* (the full list, as before); each component's line says what it does for you; and the run ends with a summary (a green check, harnesses, profile, components, the equivalent command and the next steps). A profile never selects a component a flag turned off or a destructive one. Flags and `--yes` are unchanged.
 - `downshift report` opens with what the agents pane shows, per harness: tokens saved, share of raw output cut, runs and compacted, hook against direct calls, bytes read back with `retrieve`, spawns by model change, effort change and held, and the share of subagent tokens on a cheaper model (`summary_by_harness` in `--json`). The family table gains a `cut` column.
 - `downshift report --daily` and `--history` add `runs` and `compacted` per harness, so a day with runs and nothing compacted reads apart from a day with no runs.

+// Copyright (c) 2026 Tiago Vilas Boas.
+// SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+
+package main
+
+import (
+	"slices"
+
+	"github.com/tiagovilasboas/downshift-ai/internal/console/setupwizard"
+)
+
+// essentialComponents are the parts that cut tokens on their own: the hooks
+// (routing and the compactor), the plugin that carries them in Claude Code,
+// the steering that tells other harnesses to compact, and the project policy
+// that runs Explore on the small model.
+var essentialComponents = []string{"hooks", "plugin", "steering", "policy"}
+
+// wizardPresets offers Essential first (what Enter picks), Complete (every
+// component that is on by default) and Custom (the full list). A preset only
+// selects components that start selected, so a flag such as --no-mcp or a
+// missing project directory still holds; a destructive one is never chosen.
+func wizardPresets(cs []setupwizard.Component) []setupwizard.Preset {
+	var essential, complete []string
+	for _, c := range cs {
+		if !c.Default || c.Destructive {
+			continue
+		}
+		complete = append(complete, c.ID)
+		if slices.Contains(essentialComponents, c.ID) {
+			essential = append(essential, c.ID)
+		}
+	}
+	return []setupwizard.Preset{
+		{ID: "essential", Label: "Essential (recommended)", Components: essential,
+			Hint: "right model per subagent, shorter test output; nothing else"},
+		{ID: "complete", Label: "Complete", Components: complete, AskChoice: true,
+			Hint: "Essential plus the MCP server, skills, the live pane and session policy"},
+		{ID: "custom", Label: "Custom", Custom: true, Hint: "pick each component with space"},
+	}
+}

+// Copyright (c) 2026 Tiago Vilas Boas.

+package main
+
+import (
+	"bytes"
+	"reflect"
+	"strings"

+
+	"github.com/tiagovilasboas/downshift-ai/internal/console/setupwizard"

+func presetByID(ps []setupwizard.Preset) map[string]setupwizard.Preset {
+	out := map[string]setupwizard.Preset{}
+	for _, p := range ps {
+		out[p.ID] = p
+	}
+	return out
+}
+
+func TestWizardPresets(t *testing.T) {
+	o := setup.Options{Mcp: true, ProjectDir: t.TempDir()}
+	ps := wizardPresets(wizardComponents(o))
+	if ps[0].ID != "essential" {
+		t.Fatalf("first preset = %q, want essential (what Enter picks)", ps[0].ID)
+	}
+	by := presetByID(ps)
+	if got := by["essential"].Components; !reflect.DeepEqual(got, []string{"hooks", "plugin", "steering", "policy"}) {
+		t.Errorf("essential = %v", got)
+	}
+	complete := by["complete"].Components
+	for _, id := range []string{"hooks", "mcp", "plugin", "mods", "session-policy", "skills", "steering", "policy"} {
+		if !strings.Contains(" "+strings.Join(complete, " ")+" ", " "+id+" ") {
+			t.Errorf("complete lacks %s: %v", id, complete)
+		}
+	}
+	for _, p := range ps {
+		for _, id := range p.Components {
+			if id == "prune" || id == "you-should-know" {
+				t.Errorf("%s selects %s, which must stay opt-in", p.ID, id)
+			}
+		}
+	}
+	if !by["custom"].Custom || !by["complete"].AskChoice || by["essential"].AskChoice {
+		t.Errorf("custom/complete/essential flags wrong: %+v", ps)
+	}
+}
+
+func TestWizardPresetsKeepFlagsThatTurnedComponentsOff(t *testing.T) {
+	// --no-plugin and no project directory: Essential must not bring them back.
+	o := setup.Options{NoPlugin: true}
+	by := presetByID(wizardPresets(wizardComponents(o)))
+	if got := by["essential"].Components; !reflect.DeepEqual(got, []string{"hooks", "steering"}) {
+		t.Errorf("essential = %v, want hooks and steering only", got)
+	}
+}
+
+func TestSetupSummary(t *testing.T) {
+	t.Setenv("NO_COLOR", "1")
+	var b bytes.Buffer
+	writeSetupSummary(&b, theme.New(), setupwizard.Selection{
+		Harnesses: []string{"claude-code"}, Components: []string{"hooks", "plugin"}, Preset: "essential",
+	})
+	out := b.String()
+	for _, want := range []string{"✓ ", "Downshift is set up", "Harnesses", "claude-code", "Profile",
+		"Essential", "Components", "hooks, plugin", "downshift setup claude-code", "1. Open a new session", "downshift doctor", "downshift stats"} {
+		if !strings.Contains(out, want) {
+			t.Errorf("summary lacks %q:\n%s", want, out)
+		}
+	}
+}

+// presetNames are the short names of wizardPresets, for the summary.
+var presetNames = map[string]string{"essential": "Essential", "complete": "Complete", "custom": "Custom"}
+
+// writeSetupSummary is the closing block of a wizard run: what was set up,
+// the same setup as one command, and the three next steps.
+func writeSetupSummary(w io.Writer, th theme.Theme, sel setupwizard.Selection) {
+	label := func(s string) string { return th.Muted.Render(fmt.Sprintf("  %-11s ", s)) }
+	fmt.Fprintf(w, "\n%s %s\n", th.OK.Render(theme.SymOK), th.Bold.Render("Downshift is set up"))
+	fmt.Fprintf(w, "%s%s\n", label("Harnesses"), strings.Join(sel.Harnesses, ", "))
+	if name := presetNames[sel.Preset]; name != "" {
+		fmt.Fprintf(w, "%s%s\n", label("Profile"), name)
+	}
+	fmt.Fprintf(w, "%s%s\n", label("Components"), strings.Join(sel.Components, ", "))
+	fmt.Fprintf(w, "\n  %s\n    %s\n", th.Muted.Render("The same setup without the wizard:"),
+		th.Accent.Render(setupwizard.EquivalentCommand(sel, selectionArgs)))
+	fmt.Fprintf(w, "\n  %s\n", th.Bold.Render("Next"))
+	steps := [][2]string{
+		{"", "Open a new session of your harness."},
+		{"downshift doctor", "checks every connection"},
+		{"downshift stats", "shows the tokens you save"},
+	}
+	for i, st := range steps {
+		if st[0] == "" {
+			fmt.Fprintf(w, "    %d. %s\n", i+1, st[1])
+			continue
+		}
+		fmt.Fprintf(w, "    %d. %s  %s\n", i+1, th.Accent.Render(fmt.Sprintf("%-17s", st[0])), th.Muted.Render(st[1]))
+	}
 }

-The wizard has four steps. **Harnesses**: every harness setup supports, detected ones checked. **Components**: hooks (always on), MCP server, Claude Code plugin, the downshift-agents mod, session policy, skills, steering and agent triggers, the project policy offer, You should know (off) and removing other `downshift` binaries (off, destructive). Space toggles, `a` checks all, `n` none. **Review**: the diff, one file at a time (`tab` next file, `g`/`G` top and bottom). **Confirm**: one yes or no; it defaults to No when a destructive component is checked. `esc` goes back a step and `ctrl+c` cancels. After applying, the wizard prints the equivalent `downshift setup ...` command, so the same choice can be scripted.
+The wizard draws in place below the command, not full screen, so your choices stay in the terminal history. **Harnesses**: every harness setup supports, detected ones checked. **Profile**: *Essential* (the default) installs what cuts tokens on its own: the hooks, the Claude Code plugin, the steering that tells other harnesses to compact, and the project policy that runs Explore on the small model; *Complete* adds everything else that is on by default (MCP server, skills, the downshift-agents mod, session policy) and asks about worker tools; *Custom* opens the full list. A profile never brings back a component a flag turned off, and never picks a destructive one. **Components** (Custom only): hooks (always on), MCP server, Claude Code plugin, the downshift-agents mod, session policy, skills, steering and agent triggers, the project policy offer, You should know (off) and removing other `downshift` binaries (off, destructive), each with one line on what it does for you. Space toggles, `a` checks all, `n` none. **Review**: the diff, one file at a time (`tab` next file, `g`/`G` top and bottom). **Confirm**: one yes or no; it defaults to No when a destructive component is checked. `esc` goes back a step and `ctrl+c` cancels. After applying, the wizard prints a summary (harnesses, profile, components), the equivalent `downshift setup ...` command, so the same choice can be scripted, and the next steps.
 
 For Claude Code, `setup` wires `PreToolUse` (matcher `Agent|Task`), `PostToolUse`, `PostToolUseFailure` and `SubagentStop`, sets the statusline when none exists, and sets `"model": "opusplan"` (Opus in plan mode, Sonnet for execution), `"permissions": {"defaultMode": "plan"}` (sessions start in plan mode) for keys you have not set; existing values are kept, and `--no-session-policy` skips both. Claude Code's built-in You should know mod (`"enabledPlugins": {"cc-plugin-you-should-know@builtin": true}`) is opt-in because each check is a billed background request to the session's model: `setup` prints a suggestion, and `downshift setup --you-should-know` writes it (`/plugin disable cc-plugin-you-should-know@builtin` turns it off) ([main session policy](../reference/session-models.md#main-session-policy-plan-mode-and-opusplan-claude-code)). It also finds Cursor, OpenCode, Codex, Antigravity and KiroCrew (Experimental), keeps unrelated keys and existing hooks, and is idempotent. `downshift setup --undo` restores the latest backup. A file that is a link is skipped on its own, with the reason and the fix; the rest of that harness is still set up. The "did not exist" markers and the backups of files inside plugin, skill and mod folders are kept in `~/.downshift/backups/<stamp>/`, so harness folders hold only what setup installed; older ones beside the files still work for `--undo`. KiroCrew (Experimental) gets a generated wrapper and a `preToolUse` entry in its existing `config.json`; see [KiroCrew](#kirocrew-policy-mode-through-the-native-kiro-cli-hook). The manual JSON is in [Manual setup](#manual-setup-claude-code) below.

new file mode 100644
index 00000000..5d66ad81

+++ b/internal/console/setupwizard/path.go

+// Copyright (c) 2026 Tiago Vilas Boas.
+// SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+
+package setupwizard
+
+import tea "charm.land/bubbletea/v2"
+
+// path is the sequence of steps shown for the current choices. Before a
+// preset is picked it is the longest one (the custom path).
+func (m Model) path() []step {
+	p := []step{stepHarnesses}
+	if m.hasPresets() {
+		p = append(p, stepPreset)
+	}
+	if m.custom() {
+		p = append(p, stepComponents)
+	}
+	if m.choiceInPath() {
+		p = append(p, stepChoice)
+	}
+	return append(p, stepReview, stepConfirm)
+}
+
+// total is the number of steps on the current path.
+func (m Model) total() int { return len(m.path()) }
+
+// ordinal is the 1-based position of the current step on the path.
+func (m Model) ordinal() int {
+	for i, s := range m.path() {
+		if s == m.step {
+			return i + 1
+		}
+	}
+	return 1
+}
+
+// back moves to the step before the current one on the path. Leaving the
+// review drops a preview still in flight.
+func (m Model) back() (Model, tea.Cmd) {
+	p := m.path()
+	prev := stepHarnesses
+	for i, s := range p {
+		if s == m.step && i > 0 {
+			prev = p[i-1]
+		}
+	}
+	if m.step == stepReview {
+		m.gen++
+		m.loading = false
+	}
+	switch prev {
+	case stepPreset:
+		return m.enterPreset(), nil
+	case stepChoice:
+		return m.enterChoice(), nil
+	}
+	m.step = prev
+	return m, nil
+}
+
+// afterComponents is the step that follows the component list.
+func (m Model) afterComponents() (Model, tea.Cmd) {
+	if m.choiceInPath() {
+		return m.enterChoice(), nil
+	}
+	return m.startReview()
+}

+// Copyright (c) 2026 Tiago Vilas Boas.
+// SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+
+package setupwizard
+
+import (
+	"reflect"
+	"regexp"
+	"strings"
+	"testing"
+
+	tea "charm.land/bubbletea/v2"
+)
+
+func presetOptions() Options {
+	o := sampleOptions(nil)
+	o.Choice = &Choice{ID: "workers", Title: "Worker tools", Items: []ChoiceItem{
+		{ID: "read", Label: "read (recommended)"}, {ID: "off", Label: "off"},
+	}}
+	o.Presets = []Preset{
+		{ID: "essential", Label: "Essential (recommended)", Hint: "hooks only", Components: []string{"hooks", "prune-binaries"}},
+		{ID: "complete", Label: "Complete", Hint: "everything safe", Components: []string{"hooks", "mcp"}, AskChoice: true},
+		{ID: "custom", Label: "Custom", Hint: "pick each one", Custom: true},
+	}
+	return o
+}
+
+// review runs the pending preview command, as deliverPreview does after an Enter.
+func review(t *testing.T, m Model, cmd tea.Cmd) Model {
+	t.Helper()
+	if m.step != stepReview {
+		t.Fatalf("step = %d, want review", m.step)
+	}
+	for _, c := range flatten(cmd) {
+		if msg, ok := c().(previewMsg); ok {
+			m, _ = m.Update(msg)
+		}
+	}
+	return m
+}
+
+func TestPresetEssentialSkipsTheListAndTheQuestion(t *testing.T) {
+	m := press(newModel(t, presetOptions()), enter)
+	if m.step != stepPreset || m.ordinal() != 2 {
+		t.Fatalf("step=%d ordinal=%d, want the preset step second", m.step, m.ordinal())
+	}
+	m, cmd := m.Update(enter) // Essential is first
+	m = review(t, m, cmd)
+	sel := m.Selection()
+	// prune-binaries is destructive: a preset never selects it.
+	if !reflect.DeepEqual(sel.Components, []string{"hooks"}) || sel.Preset != "essential" || sel.Choice != "" {
+		t.Fatalf("selection = %+v", sel)
+	}
+	if m.ordinal() != 3 || m.total() != 4 {
+		t.Errorf("review is step %d/%d, want 3/4", m.ordinal(), m.total())
+	}
+}
+
+func TestPresetCompleteAsksTheQuestion(t *testing.T) {
+	m := press(newModel(t, presetOptions()), enter, down, enter)
+	if m.step != stepChoice {
+		t.Fatalf("step = %d, want the question", m.step)
+	}
+	m, cmd := m.Update(enter)
+	m = review(t, m, cmd)
+	sel := m.Selection()
+	if !reflect.DeepEqual(sel.Components, []string{"hooks", "mcp"}) || sel.Choice != "read" || sel.Preset != "complete" {
+		t.Fatalf("selection = %+v", sel)
+	}
+}
+
+func TestPresetCustomOpensTheList(t *testing.T) {
+	m := press(newModel(t, presetOptions()), enter, down, down, enter)
+	if m.step != stepComponents || m.ordinal() != 3 || m.total() != 6 {
+		t.Fatalf("step=%d at %d/%d, want the component list at 3/6", m.step, m.ordinal(), m.total())
+	}
+	if m = press(m, enter); m.step != stepChoice {
+		t.Fatalf("step = %d, want the question after the list", m.step)
+	}
+}
+
+func TestPresetBackGoesThroughThePath(t *testing.T) {
+	m := press(newModel(t, presetOptions()), enter)
+	m, _ = m.Update(enter) // Essential, now on the review
+	if m = press(m, esc); m.step != stepPreset {
+		t.Fatalf("esc from the review: step %d, want the presets", m.step)
+	}
+	if !strings.Contains(m.View(), "› Essential") && !strings.Contains(m.View(), "> Essential") {
+		t.Errorf("the cursor should stay on the preset picked:\n%s", m.View())
+	}
+	if m = press(m, esc); m.step != stepHarnesses {
+		t.Fatalf("esc from the presets: step %d, want the harnesses", m.step)
+	}
+	m = press(m, enter, down, down, enter, enter) // Custom, list, question
+	if m = press(m, esc); m.step != stepComponents {
+		t.Fatalf("esc from the question on the custom path: step %d, want the list", m.step)
+	}
+	if m = press(m, esc); m.step != stepPreset {
+		t.Fatalf("esc from the list: step %d, want the presets", m.step)
+	}
+}
+
+func TestDoneLeavesOneLineInTheScrollback(t *testing.T) {
+	m := press(newModel(t, presetOptions()), enter)
+	m, cmd := m.Update(enter)
+	m = review(t, m, cmd)
+	m = press(m, enter, keyY)
+	if !m.Done() {
+		t.Fatal("not done after yes")
+	}
+	got := regexp.MustCompile(`\x1b\[[0-9;]*m`).ReplaceAllString(m.View(), "")
+	if got != "✓ Setting up claude-code, codex · Essential (recommended): hooks\n" {
+		t.Errorf("done line = %q", got)
+	}
+	if c := press(newModel(t, presetOptions()), ctrlC); c.View() != "" {
+		t.Errorf("a cancelled wizard leaves %q, want nothing", c.View())
+	}
+}
+
+func TestGoldenPresetStep(t *testing.T) {
+	m := newModel(t, presetOptions())
+	m, _ = m.Update(tea.WindowSizeMsg{Width: 80, Height: 20})
+	golden(t, "w80_2_presets", press(m, enter).View())
+}

+// Copyright (c) 2026 Tiago Vilas Boas.
+// SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+
+package setupwizard
+
+import (
+	"strings"
+
+	tea "charm.land/bubbletea/v2"
+	"github.com/tiagovilasboas/downshift-ai/internal/console/shared/frame"
+	"github.com/tiagovilasboas/downshift-ai/internal/console/shared/pick"
+)
+
+// Preset is a ready-made set of components, asked right after the harnesses.
+// A Custom preset opens the component list; any other one selects its
+// Components and skips the list. AskChoice keeps the optional question
+// (Options.Choice) on a non-custom path. The first preset is the one Enter
+// picks, so the caller puts the recommended one there.
+type Preset struct {
+	ID, Label, Hint string
+	Components      []string
+	Custom          bool
+	AskChoice       bool
+}
+
+func (m Model) hasPresets() bool { return len(m.o.Presets) > 0 }
+
+// chosenPreset is the preset picked, or nil before the pick (or without presets).
+func (m Model) chosenPreset() *Preset {
+	if m.presetIdx < 0 || m.presetIdx >= len(m.o.Presets) {
+		return nil
+	}
+	return &m.o.Presets[m.presetIdx]
+}
+
+// custom reports whether the component list is part of the path: always
+// without presets, and before a preset is picked (the longest path).
+func (m Model) custom() bool {
+	p := m.chosenPreset()
+	return !m.hasPresets() || p == nil || p.Custom
+}
+
+// choiceInPath reports whether the optional question is asked on this path.
+func (m Model) choiceInPath() bool {
+	if !m.hasChoice() {
+		return false
+	}
+	p := m.chosenPreset()
+	return m.custom() || (p != nil && p.AskChoice)
+}
+
+// enterPreset shows the presets with the cursor on the last one picked.
+func (m Model) enterPreset() Model {
+	m.step = stepPreset
+	items := make([]pick.Item, 0, len(m.o.Presets))
+	for _, p := range m.o.Presets {
+		items = append(items, pick.Item{ID: p.ID, Label: p.Label, Hint: p.Hint})
+	}
+	m.preset = pick.NewList(items)
+	m.preset.SetSize(m.width, 0)
+	for i := 0; i < m.presetIdx; i++ {
+		m.preset, _ = m.preset.Update(tea.KeyPressMsg{Code: tea.KeyDown})
+	}
+	return m
+}
+
+// applyPreset records the pick and moves on: the component list for a custom
+// preset, else the preset's components, then the question or the review.
+func (m Model) applyPreset(id string) (Model, tea.Cmd) {
+	for i, p := range m.o.Presets {
+		if p.ID == id {
+			m.presetIdx = i
+		}
+	}
+	p := m.chosenPreset()
+	if p == nil || p.Custom {
+		m.step = stepComponents
+		return m, nil
+	}
+	m.components = pick.NewMultiSelect(presetItems(m.o.Components, p.Components))
+	m.components.SetSize(m.width, m.height-4)
+	m.answer = ""
+	if m.choiceInPath() {
+		return m.enterChoice(), nil
+	}
+	return m.startReview()
+}
+
+// presetItems selects exactly ids, keeping fixed components as they are and
+// never selecting a destructive one.
+func presetItems(cs []Component, ids []string) []pick.Item {
+	want := map[string]bool{}
+	for _, id := range ids {
+		want[id] = true
+	}
+	items := componentItems(cs)
+	for i, c := range cs {
+		if !c.Disabled {
+			items[i].Selected = want[c.ID] && !c.Destructive
+		}
+	}
+	return items
+}
+
+func (m Model) viewPreset() string {
+	lines := strings.Split(m.preset.View(), "\n")
+	if n := len(lines); n >= 2 { // drop the list's own blank line and footer
+		lines = lines[:n-2]
+	}
+	body := m.th.Bold.Render("How much do you want to install?") + "\n" + strings.Join(lines, "\n")
+	return m.screen(body, []frame.Key{{Key: "↑/↓", Help: "move"}, {Key: "enter", Help: "choose"}, {Key: "esc", Help: "back"}})
+}

@@ -64,8 +53,21 @@ func (m Model) View() string {

+	case stepPreset:

+// doneLine recaps the confirmed choice in one line.
+func (m Model) doneLine() string {
+	sel := m.Selection()
+	what := strings.Join(sel.Components, ", ")
+	if p := m.chosenPreset(); p != nil && !p.Custom {
+		what = p.Label + ": " + what
+	}
+	return m.th.OK.Render(theme.SymOK) + " " + m.th.Bold.Render("Setting up") + " " +
+		strings.Join(sel.Harnesses, ", ") + m.th.Muted.Render(" · "+what) + "\n"
+}
